episode.title: This GIANT PRAYING MANTIS Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a built jungle set, a colossal praying mantis slowly turns its head towards a performer, who then disappears into its mouth, only for crew members to later pry open its mandibles to reveal him unharmed.

shots.prompt:
SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators with their rigs in the foreground. One giant creature faces exactly one man, who stands his ground and watches its jaws begin to part.

SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators in the foreground. One colossal green praying mantis, with finely segmented emerald chitin, large compound eyes that shimmer with iridescent flecks, and sharp serrated mandibles, towering over seven metres tall, faces Ihsan, who stands his ground on the jungle floor and watches its mandibles begin to part. Ambient sound only: rustling leaves, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 2, TAKEN INSIDE. The creature's jaws open wide and close over exactly one man until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth, and the creature settles with the man nowhere in frame. The crew keep filming.
